actual: Production MiniQMT sync-snapshot still returns HTTP 500 on repeated sync after BUG-249 because PostgreSQL evaluates qmt_strategy.cash_ledger balance CHECK constraints before ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. A previously settled buy fill can be replayed with a now-invalid hypothetical cash_after/frozen_after payload, so the duplicate cash_id path raises CheckViolation instead of returning inserted=false. Reproduce: POST /api/v1/qmt/virtual-strategies/sync-snapshot for account 62266303 trade_date 2026-06-04 after settlement; cash_id cash_62266303_2026-06-04_buy_fill_1010000032580354 already exists but insert fails ck_qmt_strategy_cash_ledger_balances.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
